prompt:
Read this vocabulary list in clear American English at a relaxed teaching pace. Pause silently for two seconds between entries. Read each entry once, without an introduction or commentary:

membership.

trial class.

waiver.

posted rules.

quiet area.

changing room.

locker.

equipment.
words: paid permission to use a place regularly
one class before you decide to join
a form about risk and responsibility
a place where people should be calm or silent
a room where people change their clothes
a small cupboard you can lock to store your things
the items or machines used for an activity
